cards.title: Their Maybe
cards.body: When someone tells you they "don't know what they want," it often feels like you're paused in amber, waiting for a decision that might never come. What it usually means is they're either genuinely figuring things out, they already know but aren't ready to say it, or they're content with the status quo without commitment. The crucial part? Their uncertainty doesn't have to define your certainty about what *you* need. Your time, clarity, and peace of mind are non-negotiable. Don't indefinitely put your own life on hold while someone else works out their timeline. How long is too long to wait for a "maybe"?
cards.caption:
That feeling of being in limbo can be exhausting. When have you decided enough is enough?
